⚠️  **Important: Strimzi 1.3.1 supports only Kubernetes 1.32 and newer. Kubernetes 1.30 and 1.31 are not supported anymore.**

⚠️ ⚠️ ⚠️ **Important: From Strimzi 1.0.0, the only supported version of CRD API is `v1`. The older `v1beta2`, `v1beta1`, and `v1alpha1` APIs are no longer supported. Before upgrading to Strimzi 1.0.0 and above, make sure to [convert all custom resources and upgrade the CRDs](https://strimzi.io/docs/operators/1.0.0/deploying.html#assembly-api-conversion-str).**

----

## Main Changes Since 1.3.0

The most important new features are:

* Added support for Kafka 4.3.2
* Fix concurrency issues after Vert.x removal
* Dependency updates (Cruise Control, Vert.x, Netty, Strimzi Kafka Bridge, Kafka Exporter, Strimzi OAuth, Jackson) 

### Major changes, deprecations, and removals

* PKCS12 format certificates are deprecated.
  The `STRIMZI_PKCS12_KEYSTORE_GENERATION` env var will be set to false by default in a future release.
* Kaniko is removed and Buildah is the only tool used for building Connect images.

All changes can be found under the [1.3.1 milestone](https://github.com/strimzi/strimzi-kafka-operator/milestone/66).

### Upgrading from Strimzi 1.3.0

See the [documentation for upgrade instructions](https://strimzi.io/docs/operators/in-development/deploying.html#assembly-upgrade-str).

### Maven Artifacts

To test the Maven artifacts that are part of this release, use the `1.3.1` version in your `pom.xml`.
